flags.title: Blue Nile 14K comfort-fit solitaire ($935) says "18k yellow gold" in prose and misses $1,000 warranty floor
flags.finding: On item 203284 (Stock 501146y14), the title and Metal specification state "14K Yellow Gold" at "$935 (Setting Price)", but the Product Details paragraph on the same page states "crafted in 18k yellow gold". On the same page, Blue Nile's Limited Lifetime Warranty states: "We warrant all gold and platinum jewelry items with a purchase price of $1,000 or more from manufacturer's defect" — leaving a standalone $935 setting $65 below that stated threshold.
flags.buyer_action: Get written confirmation of 14K vs 18K alloy and confirm whether warranty coverage applies when the setting is purchased below $1,000.

flags.title: Mejuri labels hollowed rings "solid gold" — directly conflicting with FTC 16 CFR § 23.3(c)(1)
flags.affected: Mejuri catalog & FAQ (e.g. bold-chain-ring; verify solid construction on mej-2mm, mej-db, mej-deb, mej-bde, mej-10k-dlr, mej-10k-sig)
flags.finding: Under eCFR 16 CFR § 23.3(c)(1) (current 2026-10-21), FTC Jewelry Guides state it is unfair or deceptive to mark, describe, or otherwise represent any karat gold item with a hollow center as "Solid Gold". Yet Mejuri's official FAQ states hollow-form pieces are "still considered solid gold", and Mejuri's live Bold Chain Ring page simultaneously lists "Material: 10k Yellow Gold", "Specifications: Hollowed 14K gold" (a 10K vs 14K internal contradiction), and image alt text "handcrafted in hollowed 14k solid gold".
flags.buyer_action: Ask any seller in writing whether a ring is solid throughout (non-hollow, non-electroformed) — not merely unplated — and verify expected mass by gram weight and specific gravity.

flags.title: Two Anna Sheffield listings have no live HTML price or Add-to-Bag button (custom client archive pages)
flags.finding: Opening the live HTML pages for as-bea-sol and as-hazeline reveals no retail price and no checkout button; instead both display a custom inquiry form stating: "While this one-of-a-kind piece was made for a client, we are able to create a unique version just for you within your desired price range." Their recorded prices ($5,750 and $5,800–$8,500) exist only in Shopify's underlying product JSON feed for previously sold pieces, whereas as-bea-3stone ($5,400–$25,100) has a live Add-to-Bag button.
flags.buyer_action: Treat as-bea-sol and as-hazeline prices as historical archive figures; request a current written quote and return eligibility before commissioning a custom build (custom Anna Sheffield orders are final sale).

flags.title: Aurate New York holds a BBB "F" rating and displays "Final Sale! Exchange for size only" on ring PDPs
flags.finding: Independent BBB verification (bbb.org, NY profile 0121-170321) shows Aurate New York is Not BBB Accredited and carries an "F" rating due to "Failure to respond to 8 complaint(s) filed against business" (23 complaints filed; 1.22/5 across 18 customer reviews). Furthermore, live HTML product pages for au-2ct-oval and au-cigar display "Final Sale! / Exchange only! / Exchange for size only" directly above a generic "Free Returns" marketing icon, and opening au-cigar without a variant query string defaults to the $118 Vermeil / Sterling Silver option.
flags.buyer_action: Do not assume Aurate rings are refundable from the "Free Returns" badge. Screenshot checkout terms, verify the 14K/18K gold variant is selected (never Vermeil), and pay only with a credit card.

flags.title: With Clarity caps returns at 1 per 6 months — subsequent orders become final sale
flags.finding: With Clarity's official Terms & Conditions (Renaissance FMI Inc., Long Island City, NY) allow 1 return or exchange per customer every 6 months within 30 calendar days of receipt; any additional orders placed within 6 months of a prior return are automatically final sale. Similarly, Blue Nile caps free US returns at 2 per calendar year and starts its 30-day clock at shipment rather than delivery, while Brilliant Earth starts its 30-day clock when the order is available for shipment/pickup and prohibits comparative purchasing.
flags.buyer_action: Never order multiple rings to compare side-by-side without checking comparative-purchasing and return-frequency caps first.

flags.title: Surface XRF alone can be fooled by electroformed resin cores and "gold-plated gold" (GIA Lab Notes 2024–2025)
flags.finding: GIA Gems & Gemology Lab Notes document two critical failure modes of standalone XRF testing because X-ray fluorescence reads only a shallow surface layer (microns): (1) Spring 2024 (Vol. 60, No. 1): a 41 g electroformed gold-plated resin bracelet with a glued-on 14K stamped disk read 17.99K–22.47K on XRF with no plating alert; (2) Summer 2025 (Vol. 61, No. 2, "Gold-Plated Gold"): 9K and 10K rings/chains plated with higher-karat yellow gold read 13.5K–18K on XRF without triggering a plating warning.
flags.buyer_action: Ask your independent jeweller/appraiser to pair XRF with precision gram weighing + hydrostatic specific-gravity (density) testing and microscopic inspection inside the return window.

flags.title: Menē 24K pure-gold bands omit static HTML gram numbers and carry ±1 g Crafted-on-Demand weight variance + 10% refund restocking fee
flags.finding: Menē prices 24K Investment Jewelry principally by precious-metal weight, but its server-rendered HTML product pages display the USD price ($1,720 Classic Band; $1,372 Narrow Classic Band) while placing the gram breakdown behind a client-side script. Under the zero-hallucination rule, gram weight is left blank rather than back-calculated from spot. Menē's Terms of Service (effective Sep 2, 2026) also state Crafted-on-Demand weights may vary by ±1.0 g (final weight printed on the Certificate of Authenticity), discretionary returns must be initiated within 7 days of receipt, original-payment refunds may incur up to a 10% restocking fee (100% value for Menē Credit), and missing the Certificate of Authenticity triggers a 5% assessment fee.
flags.buyer_action: Read the exact gram weight from the live Price Breakdown before checkout, verify it against the Certificate of Authenticity and a jeweller's scale within 7 days of delivery, and note the 10% cash-refund restocking fee.
